how-refunds-work.html:
How do refunds work?

A refund is the negative of the amount paid. alpha-lib's refund function computes it, and beta-app calls it through the @example/alpha-lib package.

const owed = refund(amount); // amount > 0 && owed < 0, in beta-app
flowchart LR
  pay["beta-app: PaymentService.pay"] --> refund["alpha-lib: refund"]

who-approves-refunds.html:
Who approves refunds?

The payments team approves refunds over the daily limit. The code does not enforce an approval: it is a team practice.
